**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of the problem. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Additional context**
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.

**Note**
Please keep requests within the project's scope as described in
[BOUNDARIES.md](../../BOUNDARIES.md). Features that rely on the
stream-extraction route or on shipping third-party proprietary code are
out of scope and will be declined.
